text:
anna-ptl: Quick sync — inc-832 postmortem actions, I'm seeing a couple slips and cross-team blockers. Can owners confirm status and new due dates? (cc @kevin-sre @mike-eng @sarah-pm) :wave:

mike-eng: PR for metrics aggregation still needs infra review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412. I asked infra team on Monday, they said backlog. New ETA Thu 03/26 if reviewed today.

kevin-sre: I'm owning the canary rollback doc and runbook. 80% done, finishing runbook steps today. Plan to ship by Wed 03/25. No blockers from my side.

sarah-pm: I'm on the customer comms draft, need legal review for wording. Legal pinged, expect signoff Fri 03/27.

ops-bot: reminder: inc-832 action item 4 (quota fix) assigned to @olivia-dev is overdue by 2 days.

olivia-dev: sorry, got pulled to an infra fire last week. ETA bump to Mon 03/30, but can hand off tests to mike if needed.

mike-eng: I can pick up unit tests tomorrow if olivia writes clear acceptance criteria. @anna-ptl should we reassign to avoid further slip?

anna-ptl: Let's reassign action 4 to mike as temporary owner, original owner remains reviewer. olivia please add acceptance criteria by EOD.

olivia-dev: will add AC by EOD. thx.

kevin-sre: Also flag: metric retention change requires a DB migration window — might need cross-team signoff from storage. @james-storage?

james-storage: got it, migration window noted. We can do 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-02 low-traffic window but need final approval from infra. I'll coordinate with infra-ptl.

mike-eng: For infra review, I left a comment on the PR requesting schema migration notes. If we can't get review by Tue, propose temporary feature flag + incremental rollout plan.

sarah-pm: Customer-facing timeline depends on migration date. If migration is 4/1, we draft comms for 4/3. I'll hold off until owners + dates are locked.

anna-ptl: Action items update — I'll post a small owners table after this thread. Current temporary reassignments: action4 -> mike-eng, runbook -> kevin-sre, comms -> sarah-pm. If anyone objects, speak up now.

mike-eng: ok.

kevin-sre: fine.

olivia-dev: ok with that, will review PR later and help with testing handoff.

anna-ptl: Thanks all. I'll publish the follow-up doc and updated due dates by EOD. If infra review blocks the PR, we'll escalate to infra-ptl and schedule an exec sync. :thumbsup:
